note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the wallace_2026_s2c_mc cache into this table's own cache dir; sha256 77e72d25dd6fc1f8800272508884584543e1b81e4b452795fbf26e8c40e4732e verified; the S2c .sps contains no MetaCog line). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2c_metacog.csv = (s2c, [(MetaCog{i} -> metacog{i}, rev 0) for i in 1,2]): a number-preserving lowercase rename of the source column name (.sav columns 0-based 47-48, between voluncert and mindsetprior). No '-' flip prefix, so resp is the deposited value and the live table has no itemcov_recoded column (confirmed: live columns id,item,resp,treat,cov_*). Exempt from Step 5b (number-preserving rename), no verification files. TEXT: both variable labels shipped verbatim (no line-break artifacts, no numbering). No lead-in in either label, instructions left blank. OPTIONS: value labels identical on both items: 1='1 - very much', 2..6 bare digits, 7='7 - not at all'; shipped as 'very much'/'not at all' with the number prefixes stripped (sibling convention, e.g. wallace_2026_reflection) and original lower case kept; 2-6 blank, not padded. DIRECTION: 1 = very much, so a higher resp means LESS thinking about the organization's influence, matching the processing-script docstring ('_s2c_metacog ... run 1 = very much ... 7 = not at all, as deposited'). INSTRUMENT: the deposit names no scale; the instrument field is an IRW-descriptive label read off the item content, matching the dictionary Description 'Metacognition'. COUNTS: source 793 rows, 793 non-missing per item; live 1586 rows = 793 ids x 2; per-item resp-count vectors (1..7) source = live exactly: metacog1 94/112/169/127/108/68/115, metacog2 97/110/158/150/101/69/108. RIGHTS: study's own items, no published instrument identified, so no originator page and no instrument_rights_register.csv row applies; nothing located reserves a right, silence is permission; no register row written. Wording copied from the study's own .sav labels.
